note: The last full week before Election Day. Kimmel went after Trump's Nicki Minaj shout-out at a Michigan rally, a rally reporter he called "out of shape," and hecklers shouting about Epstein; Stewart spent his Monday on who "you" turned out to be in Trump's "for you" pitch, including a surprise aside to Skydance's Saudi investor; Fallon opened Monday with the midterm countdown. I couldn't find reliably quotable Meyers lines for these nights, so he's left out.

jokes.topic: Trump pointing out Nicki Minaj in the crowd at a Port Huron, Michigan rally and praising her "beautiful ass"
jokes.joke: Horny Donald is my least favorite Donald of all of them.
jokes.context: Also: "Can you imagine what would happen if Joe Biden said that? Steve Doocy would have to eat the Bible on camera!"

jokes.topic: Trump telling a reporter who asked about a canceled rally, "You are a sick guy... he's way out of shape"
jokes.joke: Imagine him calling someone else out of shape. Is it possible they don't have any mirrors in the White House? Maybe somebody should take him out to that Reflecting Pool, let him get a look at himself.
jokes.context: Moved on to hecklers at Trump's rallies and his claim he threw Jeffrey Epstein out of Mar-a-Lago for being "a whack job": "The minute his pedophile best friend started poaching his massage girls, that was it. He was out!"

jokes.topic: Fired press secretary Katie Zacharia's defensive interview with Piers Morgan, in which she kept saying her ouster had been "litigated and adjudicated"
jokes.joke: Did somebody maybe unplug her and plug her back in? You got to reboot that, as she's glitching again.
jokes.context: Then to Trump: "Please bring her back, just until Christmas. I would appreciate it."

jokes.topic: Trump's 2024 "President Trump is for you" slogan, two years on
jokes.joke: Trump never really told you who you was, did he? ... You was actually them. Yeah, billionaires like Elon Musk. They've done great. He was recently promoted to trillionaire.
jokes.context: Then, pointing at Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman's Skydance investment: "By the way, Your Highness, thank you for your investment in Skydance. We'll make you proud."

jokes.topic: Trump's midterm rally in deep-red Mississippi
jokes.joke: President Trump was like, 'Wow, that's one and a half press secretaries from now!' ... Right now he's about as useful as Spirit Halloween on November 1st.
jokes.context: On Mississippi possibly going blue: "It's like hearing that a Cracker Barrel inside a Bass Pro Shop could go blue, you know what I'm saying?"
